name: List games
description: Postgres builds the response: the one `body` column is json_agg / json_build_object, and since Orion 1.6 a json column decodes as the document itself, so the respond task copies it into data.body and shapes the response. Keeping response construction in SQL is deliberate -- a mistyped operator inside a map mapping is written through as a literal object with a 200, where a mistyped SQL function is a loud error. Before 1.6 the column had to be cast ::text and parsed back by a parse_json task.

input.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('id', slug, 'name', name) ORDER BY name), '[]'::json) AS body FROM games
